<?php
function peerShift233() { $GLOBALS['late'] = 99; $GLOBALS['owner'] = null; $GLOBALS['runner'] = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerBase233 {
    public $text;
    public function __construct($saved, $marker) { $this->text = $saved; echo 'CTOR:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return 9; }
    public function run($value) { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(first: false, later: new static($value, peerShift233())); }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'END:', $this->text, ';'; }
}
class PeerChild233 extends PeerBase233 {}
class PeerMagicBase233 {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { $GLOBALS['kept'] = $arguments['later']; echo 'MAGIC;'; return false; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; }
}
class PeerMagicChild233 extends PeerMagicBase233 {}
$prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $kept = null;
$owner = new PeerMagicChild233; $runner = new PeerChild233('CALLER', false);
$result = $runner->run($late);
echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'VALUE:', $kept->text, ';'; unset($kept); unset($late); echo 'AFTER;';
